risk.market: CSI300 price index; close/previous close minus1; filter cutoff before transformations
risk.window: 60 global market dates strictly before signal, t-60 through t-1
risk.model: OLS stock daily ret on intercept and CSI300 daily return
risk.beta: centered cross-product / centered market sum of squares
risk.ivol: sqrt((centered stock sum of squares - centered cross-product squared / centered market sum of squares)/(n-2))
risk.zero_or_nonfinite_market_variance: missing; no alternate index or window
risk.rank: same full frozen common-pool daily average percentile rank minus0.5; nonfinite to0
risk.risk_missing_count: number of nonfinite beta60/ivol60 divided by2 minus0.5; identical feature in all four models
risk.known_total_volatility_predictors: Existing vol20/vol60 unchanged; no duplicated new own-momentum feature

model.array_dtype: contiguous Float32 NumPy arrays, all features numeric
model.early_stopping_note: False already in B2/B2D; validation_fraction and stopping settings remain inactive; no random row holdout.

training.scheme: Annual 2020–2026; all eligible B2D signal dates in previous 3 calendar years; same rows for both models.
training_conditions: year Y: Y-3 Jan1 <= signal_date <= Y-1 Dec31
both adjusted open endpoints strictly positive and finite
at least two training signal years
training.logical_fit_time: Y Jan1 00:00:00 Asia/Shanghai, an information-time boundary, not claimed historical wall-clock training
training.predict_time: signal-day post-close, information as of 15:00 Asia/Shanghai; actual supplier arrival unknown
training.new_fit_receipt: Record actual run timestamp separately from logical information cutoff.

selection.prediction_pool: same complete frozen B2 feature rows for each model; do not screen using future labels or future trade eligibility
selection.before_label_join: Write and SHA-seal predictions and both Top20 lists before joining evaluation outcomes.
selection.primary: complete-observed mean of each fixed Top20 list; date valid only when both means finite
selection.diagnostic: same fixed Top20 lists, unavailable stock label contributes zero, denominator20; no p-values or extra claim
selection.missing_guard: Dates with zero observed outcomes cannot be silently dropped: retain calendar row, mark endpoint NA, report counts. Calendar-end immaturity is excluded by design before state gate. No reranking.

label.endpoint_join: exact frozen global calendar; never next available stock row

inference.family: Holm6: three direct paired contrasts by two fixed block lengths
inference.bootstrap: Shared circular block starts across all three paired daily contrasts, ceil(T/L) starts, truncate last block to T; retain chronological missing dates
inference.gate: at least4 years and floor(valid dates/L)>=20 per cell; invalid cell retained with correction p1
inference.claim: primary D-C positive and Holm6<.05 at both L20/L60 for supported positive conditional increment; no mediation/attenuation attribution from p differences
inference.missing: All four complete-list mean returns jointly finite for primary same-date sample; all dates retained in records; fixed-denominator missing-zero contrasts descriptive only
